info.title: OpsFlow API
info.description: Multi-tenant service-operations API. Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/login, press Authorize and paste the accessToken (without the word Bearer). Access tokens last 15 minutes; renew them with POST /api/v1/auth/refresh. Tenant APIs live under /api/v1/tenants/{tenantId}: the tenant id in the route is only a request; access is decided from the caller's active membership in the database. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code` and a `traceId`.

post.description: Anonymous. Validates user credentials and returns a JWT access token (15 minutes) and a JWT refresh token (7 days). Failures are one generic 401; repeated failures lock the account temporarily.

401.description: Invalid credentials or refresh token (generic on purpose).

post.description: Anonymous. Validates and rotates a refresh JWT sent in the JSON body and returns a new token pair. Each refresh token works exactly once: a replay revokes the session, and a racing duplicate within the grace window gets 409 without a new token.

post.description: Anonymous. Revokes the session that owns the supplied refresh token. Unknown tokens are ignored.
